title: Electrocoagulation pretreatment for total phosphorus and boron removal in waste lubricating oil regeneration wastewater: efficiency and mechanism
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,50775-50783
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08041J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Li-li Shan, Zong-mei Wu, Ze-bing Zhu, Zhao Tan, Jing-liang Dong, Qiu-zhuo Zhang, Chang-long Pang
This study demonstrates electrocoagulation simultaneously removes TP (79.0%) and B (13.5%) from WLORW, primarily via inner-/outer-sphere complexation, while enabling resource recovery (P as vivianite, energy from H2) for sustainable pretreatment.
